svg.title: From any business signal to a governed outcome
svg.desc: Move AI Fabric beyond chat into a reusable enablement layer for interactive, embedded, proactive, batch and human-governed products. One governed path from trusted application context to a typed answer, signal, review task, proposal or authoritative action result.
